sections.section_heading: What is this software testing program about?
sections.description:
Testing is often treated as an afterthought, but good testers are in real demand, and QA is a genuinely good way into the software industry if you're methodical and detail-oriented. It is also one of the few IT career paths where a non-CS background is not a barrier.

This program covers both manual testing (understanding requirements, writing test cases, finding and reporting bugs properly) and automation testing with tools like Selenium, so you're not limited to one or the other.

Labs are practical: you'll test real applications, log bugs the way a QA team actually would, and build small automation scripts rather than just learning the theory. This is a standalone course, with no prerequisite program needed.

paragraphs: A little more clarity

Our fees are deliberately affordable and student-friendly compared to large institutes, and differ between the 1-month and 3-month tracks. Contact us or book a free demo and we'll share the current fee sheet upfront, with no hidden costs.

Yes. After training we provide placement and internship support: QA-specific interview preparation, resume and portfolio guidance, and referrals toward testing openings. Your mock QA sign-off project doubles as interview-ready proof of skill.

Yes, and this is one of QA's biggest advantages as a career entry point. Manual testing requires logic and attention to detail, not programming. Automation is introduced step by step, and many successful testers started with no coding experience at all.

Start with both, which is exactly how this course is built. Manual testing teaches you to think like a tester; automation makes you more employable. Most QA job listings for freshers in Kerala now ask for basic automation exposure alongside manual skills, so learning only one limits your options.

Entry-level QA and software testing roles in Kerala typically start around ₹2.5–3.5 LPA, with automation skills pushing you toward the higher end and faster growth into QA engineer and SDET roles. (Verify and refresh this figure annually.)

Yes. Testing has changed rather than disappeared: manual-only roles are fewer, while demand for testers who combine manual thinking with automation and API testing has grown. That combination is exactly what this course teaches.
Yes, the course includes API testing basics with Postman: sending requests, validating responses, and understanding how API tests fit into a QA workflow.
Live online batches are available and offline/classroom sessions in Trivandrum. All sessions are instructor-led and interactive, never pre-recorded lectures.

Choose testing if you're detail-oriented and want a faster, lower-barrier entry into IT, especially from a non-CS background. Choose our Full Stack Developer Course (MERN) or AI & Data Science course if you want to build applications rather than verify them. The free Career Goal session can help you decide.

content.text: A little more clarity
Good questions.
What is the fee for the software testing course?+

Our fees are deliberately affordable and student-friendly compared to large institutes, and differ between the 1-month and 3-month tracks. Contact us or book a free demo and we'll share the current fee sheet upfront, with no hidden costs.
Does this course include placement support?+

Yes. After training we provide placement and internship support: QA-specific interview preparation, resume and portfolio guidance, and referrals toward testing openings. Your mock QA sign-off project doubles as interview-ready proof of skill.
Can I become a software tester without a coding background?+

Yes, and this is one of QA's biggest advantages as a career entry point. Manual testing requires logic and attention to detail, not programming. Automation is introduced step by step, and many successful testers started with no coding experience at all.
Is manual testing or automation testing better for freshers?+

Start with both, which is exactly how this course is built. Manual testing teaches you to think like a tester; automation makes you more employable. Most QA job listings for freshers in Kerala now ask for basic automation exposure alongside manual skills, so learning only one limits your options.
What is the salary of a software tester in Kerala?+

Entry-level QA and software testing roles in Kerala typically start around ₹2.5–3.5 LPA, with automation skills pushing you toward the higher end and faster growth into QA engineer and SDET roles. (Verify and refresh this figure annually.)
Is software testing still a good career in 2026?+

Yes. Testing has changed rather than disappeared: manual-only roles are fewer, while demand for testers who combine manual thinking with automation and API testing has grown. That combination is exactly what this course teaches.
Do you cover API testing?+
Yes, the course includes API testing basics with Postman: sending requests, validating responses, and understanding how API tests fit into a QA workflow.
Is the course online or offline?+
Live online batches are available and offline/classroom sessions in Trivandrum. All sessions are instructor-led and interactive, never pre-recorded lectures.
Software testing or full stack development: which should I choose?+

Choose testing if you're detail-oriented and want a faster, lower-barrier entry into IT, especially from a non-CS background. Choose our Full Stack Developer Course (MERN) or AI & Data Science course if you want to build applications rather than verify them. The free Career Goal session can help you decide.
